response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but this significantly exceeds the entry/junior-mid level scope of the role. His skill set (TypeScript, Node.js, React-adjacent Ember.js, Docker, Kubernetes) covers the required stack, though direct React/Nest.js/PostgreSQL experience isn't explicitly evidenced, and MongoDB dominates his DB history over PostgreSQL. The core risk is seniority mismatch — both in compensation expectations and role satisfaction — for a junior/mid IC position.
strengths: Deep, broad fullstack experience spanning 15+ years across many stacks and industries
Strong TypeScript/Node.js proficiency directly matching core required skill
Experience with Kubernetes and Docker, relevant to nice-to-have AWS/K8s criteria
concerns: Vastly overqualified (Staff/Senior level) for a junior/mid-level entry role, risking mismatch in expectations and retention
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience; database background leans MongoDB/MySQL
No direct experience with React specifically (Ember.js is his frontend framework of choice) or LLM/OCR/document-verification nice-to-haves
